content: I am thrilled to announce we crossed a major corporate milestone, reaching $80 million in AI-driven Annual Recurring Revenue this quarter. Our AI Platform Edition is rapidly replacing legacy relational databases across Fortune 500 accounts as the default database for generative applications.

Rajiv, on the $80 million AI ARR figure: footnote 4 in the segment disclosure notes that $65 million of that revenue reflects existing core database renewals migrated into the new SKU with vector features included. Can you disclose what your organic, net-new AI ARR expansion rate was this quarter excluding renewals?

Jason, our customers do not separate their data architecture into AI vs non-AI anymore. When an enterprise renews their database with Synthetix, they are running hybrid vector-relational workloads. We manage the platform holistically, and our consolidated net revenue retention remains very healthy at 112%.
